sweeps.name: Sweep: frontier labs & model releases
sweeps.rationale: The core capability race between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, and Meta is the pipeline's primary anchor desk; version releases and benchmark claims move fastest and are least likely to be fully covered by any single feed.

sweeps.name: Sweep: compute, chips & infrastructure
sweeps.rationale: Chip generations, foundry capacity, and hyperscaler capex now set the pace of the whole industry as much as model releases do, and this coverage lives mostly in specialist and financial press outside the core AI feeds.

sweeps.name: Sweep: AI safety, security & alignment
sweeps.rationale: Safety framework updates, third-party evals (METR, Apollo, UK AISI), and disclosed agentic-AI incidents are distinct from product-release news and are covered by a different set of publishers and government sources.

sweeps.name: Sweep: policy, regulation & geopolitics
sweeps.rationale: Binding regulation (EU AI Act enforcement, US state laws, export controls) and US-China dynamics are a standing desk with its own cadence of government and legal-press sources not captured by general tech feeds.

sweeps.name: Sweep: enterprise adoption, agents & applications
sweeps.rationale: The shift from chatbots to production agents (coding tools, enterprise platforms, vertical deployments) is where model capability actually meets revenue and is undercovered by pure-research feeds.

sweeps.name: Sweep: funding, deals & corporate strategy
sweeps.rationale: Funding rounds, cloud/compute partnerships, and the running capex-bubble debate drive a large share of daily coverage and are reported primarily by business press rather than lab or research feeds.

sweeps.name: Sweep: open source & research ecosystem
sweeps.rationale: Open-weight model drops and the academic pipeline (arXiv, NeurIPS/ICML, benchmark leaderboards) move on their own schedule, increasingly led by Chinese labs, and need dedicated discovery beyond arXiv's own feed.

sweeps.name: Sweep: talent & org dynamics
sweeps.rationale: High-profile researcher departures, spin-outs, and internal restructurings are a recurring signal of where frontier capability is migrating, and are typically broken by scoop-driven outlets rather than official channels.

sweeps.name: Sweep: robotics & embodied AI
sweeps.rationale: Physical/embodied AI is a fast-growing, capital-intensive beat that is genuinely contested as its own desk versus a subset of Enterprise Applications, so it needs explicit discovery rather than incidental pickup.
